item.title: Kinetic Typography
item.description: Project Overview Project Goal: To create an engaging kinetic typography animation for “I’m with You” by Avril Lavigne. Synchronizing expressive text movements with the song’s rhythm and emotion while applying core animation principles to enhance visual storytelling. My Role: Designer & Animator Built With: After Effect (motion graphics) Premiere Pro (video editing) Work Time: 1 Month (July 2023 - August 2023) Showcase: Project Description Kinetic Typography Animator – Music Video for Avril Lavigne’s "
